verdict.rationale: Grok can be driven programmatically without a UI. The xAI API has a quickstart for sending prompts (including to Grok Build), a published OpenAPI spec, structured JSON outputs and streaming, which together support scripted automation pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence documents a headless/non-interactive mode for the Grok Build terminal tool or any CI usage, so CI automation means building on the raw API yourself. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI integration guidance or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), API-key/auth guidance for CI environments, independent hands-on evidence of CI usage.
